name: @feldspar/payments
title: Payments
description: Take payments in your applications through a payment provider, and react to them with your own triggers.
supplies: Three tables: pay_accounts (one per configured provider, with its keys kept secret), pay_objects (a mirror of the provider's checkouts, payments, customers and subscriptions) and pay_events (one row per thing that happened, for your triggers to react to).

Payments through Stripe, through Polar (a merchant of record, which collects and pays the sales tax and VAT itself), or through a test provider ("fake") with a checkout page and a customer portal of its own, so payment screens can be built before anybody has a provider account.
Subscriptions to the plans in a table of yours: a subscriber is granted their plan's role for as long as the subscription lasts, and a plan change moves it.
Webhooks for each account's provider events, processed once each into pay_events, and a sweep that catches any the provider failed to deliver.

Actions to take a payment or a subscription for a row of your own tables (pay_checkout), to open the customer portal, change plan or cancel, to refund, to call the provider's API, and to try an account with a small test checkout.
